supportRequestDraft.subject: Review low-volume SMS verification throttling on shared store Wi-Fi and assess per-IP threshold adjustment
supportRequestDraft.body: Production iPhone phone authentication returns too-many-requests after only a few reported attempts. The same user reports success after switching from store Wi-Fi to cellular 5G. Please investigate whether IP/network anti-abuse restrictions or verification request quotas caused the failures, and assess a modest per-IP threshold adjustment for legitimate customers sharing store Wi-Fi while retaining anti-abuse protection. Total recent SMS volume is 13–67/day, below the observed project daily quota of 1,000. We have not established the exact limiter. Please advise what additional diagnostics you require.
